verdict.rationale: Copilot's agent mode can edit files and 'validate files' (docs-22), and its sandboxes let it run code and tools (docs-16). The cloud agent can work through tasks on its own, including ones triggered when an issue is opened (docs-31, docs-33). Together these imply an agentic loop that could reproduce and fix bugs, but no evidence describes a debugging workflow as such, and Autofix's contextual explanations cover only security vulnerabilities (docs-13). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reproducing bugs, root-cause analysis or debugging tooling, verifying fixes by running tests, and independent hands-on corroboration of bug-fixing effectiveness.
